_documentation.purpose: Runs the sis shapiro focused experiment or benchmark.
_documentation.relies_on: Uses only the physics values in this file.
_documentation.authority: Values in this file are authoritative for its runner. A sweep value overrides the corresponding base-simulation value only for that named case; effective values are recorded in summary.json.

fields.temperature_K: Sets temperature K; units are kelvin.
fields.critical_temperature_K: Sets critical temperature K; units are kelvin.
fields.junction.critical_current_A: Zero-field SIS critical current; null requests Ambegaokar-Baratoff calculation.
fields.junction.normal_resistance_ohm: Normal/shunt resistance of the SIS junction.
fields.extended_junction.width_m: Sets width m; units are metres.
fields.extended_junction.electrode_length_m: Sets electrode length m; units are metres.
fields.extended_junction.junction_x_m: Sets junction x m; units are metres.
fields.extended_junction.effective_magnetic_len: Sets effective magnetic length m; units are metres.
fields.extended_junction.magnetic_field_T: Sets magnetic field T; units are tesla.
fields.vortex_scenarios[].name: Human-readable identifier.
fields.vortex_scenarios[].vortices[].charge: Integer vortex winding: +1 is a vortex and -1 an antivortex.
fields.vortex_scenarios[].vortices[].electrode: Junction electrode in which the vortex is seeded.
fields.vortex_scenarios[].vortices[].x_m: Sets x m; units are metres.
fields.vortex_scenarios[].vortices[].y_m: Sets y m; units are metres.
fields.microwave_amplitudes_A: Delivered AC-current amplitudes included in the sweep.
fields.sweep_dc_values: DC drive values included in the sweep.
fields.initial_phase_rad: Initial junction phase difference in radians.
fields.run.duration_s: Sets duration s; units are seconds.
fields.run.max_step_s: Sets max step s; units are seconds.
fields.run.microwave_steps_per_cycle: Integration samples per microwave period; more samples improve resolution at greater cost.
fields.run.atol: Absolute numerical tolerance in the associated quantity's units.
fields.output.gif_microwave_amplitude_A: Sets gif microwave amplitude A; units are amperes.
fields.output.gif_bias_current_A: Sets gif bias current A; units are amperes.
fields.output.dynamic_plot_cycles: Number of final microwave cycles expanded in transient and local-current diagnostic plots.
fields.output_directory: Base output directory; runners reserve a numbered sibling if it already exists.
